purpose_context: #517 (P1, epic #143, Post-cutover): the service's part of the external org-pack lifecycle. A registered pack can be created and replaced but not removed, and a replacement is not checked against the version it replaces. The dependents check builds on the existing closure/impact machinery (#554 landed) with a seam for #556's ImpactCheck.
purpose_tldr: Add DELETE /packs/{packId}, an impact dry run of the delete and the replace, and a newer-version guard on PUT /packs/{packId}.
